project_metadata.job_title: PCB Design for ESP32 Project - Power, Main, and Sensor Boards
project_metadata.job_description: I am seeking a skilled PCB designer to create three custom PCBs for my ESP32 project: a Power Board, a Main Board, and a Sensors Board. The ideal candidate should have experience in designing compact and efficient PCBs with a focus on integration and functionality. Familiarity with the ESP32 platform and relevant design software is essential. Please provide examples of previous work related to PCB design. Your expertise will help bring my project to life effectively and efficiently.

The three boards form a chain: power board → main board → sensor board. Because the main board is in the middle, it receives power from the power board through J\_PWR\_PWR, uses that power locally, AND forwards it to the sensor board through J\_SENSOR\_PWR. It works like a power strip: power arrives through one cable, and the main board distributes it to both its own components and the sensor board through a second cable.
The INA219 is placed in-series on the 3.3V rail immediately after the Schottky diodes. It therefore gives one reading for the total 3.3V current consumed by everything downstream, including the ESP32 itself and anything drawn by the sensor board.
